# OnTheSnow

> > OnTheSnow is a comprehensive ski resort information platform providing real-time snow reports, webcams, trail maps, and user-generated reviews for ski areas across North America.

OnTheSnow serves as the go-to resource for skiers and snowboarders planning trips to mountain resorts. The platform aggregates current conditions, historical snowfall data, live webcam feeds, interactive trail maps, and firsthand visitor reports from hundreds of ski areas across the United States, with coverage spanning major destinations like Alta Ski Area, Aspen Snowmass, and smaller regional resorts.

## Key Topics

- Ski conditions and snow reports
- Live webcams and mountain cams
- Trail maps and terrain guides
- User-submitted firsthand reports
- Ski resort reviews
- Historical snowfall data
- Mountain resort coverage
- Alta Ski Area (Utah)
- Aspen Snowmass (Colorado)
- Yosemite Ski & Snowboard Area (California)
- OnTheSnow Mobile App
- Slope photos and conditions
- Resort comparison tools
- Regional ski area information

## Snow Reports & Current Conditions

- [Bogus Basin Snow Report](https://www.onthesnow.com/idaho/bogus-basin/skireport): Daily snow report & conditions for Bogus Basin, Idaho ski resort
- [Angel Fire Resort Snow Report](https://www.onthesnow.com/new-mexico/angel-fire-resort/skireport): Daily snow report & conditions for Angel Fire Resort, New Mexico
- [Alta Ski Area Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/utah/alta-ski-area/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Alta Ski Area, Utah
- [Aspen Snowmass Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/colorado/aspen-snowmass/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Aspen Snowmass, Colorado
- [Yosemite Ski & Snowboard Area Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/california/badger-pass/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Yosemite Ski & Snowboard Area
- [Boreal Mountain Resort Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/california/boreal/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Boreal Mountain Resort, CA
- [Big Powderhorn Mountain Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/michigan/big-powderhorn-mountain/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Big Powderhorn Mountain, MI
- [Ski Blandford Firsthand Reports & Photos](https://www.onthesnow.com/massachusetts/blandford-ski-area/ski-report-reviews): User-submitted snow reports & photos from Ski Blandford, Massachusetts

## Live Webcams

- [Alta Ski Area Webcams](https://www.onthesnow.com/utah/alta-ski-area/webcams): Live HD webcams & snow conditions at Alta Ski Area, Utah
- [Anthony Lakes Mountain Resort Webcams](https://www.onthesnow.com/oregon/anthony-lakes-mountain-resort/webcams): Live HD webcams & snow conditions at Anthony Lakes Mountain Resort, OR
